title: Fool Night Anime by SHAFT and SUNRISE Reveals November 26 Premiere, New Trailer, English Voice Cast
content: FOOL NIGHT anime adaptation by studios SHAFT and SUNRISE revealed a new trailer and additional voice cast members, as well as a November 26 premiere. This is the first-ever joint project between the two studios, and it was previously confirmed for a 2026 release exclusive to Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fool Night' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Teaser Promo, November 2026 Premiere
content: The Netflix panel at Anime NYC 2026 revealed additional cast members and a second teaser promotional video for the anime adaptation of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Thursday. The anime will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on November 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Keeps Doing One Thing Better Than Solo Leveling
content: Since the start of the Summer season, Crunchyroll has been streaming an anime that has been dubbed an anime like Solo Leveling due to its similar appearance and premise. title: Fool Night Anime's Teaser Reveals More Cast, November 26 Worldwide Netflix Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Friday. The teaser revealed more cast and the November 26 worldwide Netflix debut date for the anime. Netflix will debut the entire series on November 26.
author: ANN

title: THE ONE PIECE Remake by WIT Studio Reveals First Key Visual
content: THE ONE PIECE anime remake by WIT Studio has revealed its first key visual ahead of its February 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed that Mayumi Tanaka will reprise the role of Luffy in the new anime, teasing it with a teaser trailer .
author: Anime Corner

title: Please Save My Earth Manga Gets Live-Action Amazon Prime Show Starring Alice Hirose
content: Takahiro Miki (live-action Blue Spring Ride , Hodonaku, Owakare Desu , Solanin , We Were There ) is directing, and Nana Yamamoto (Vivant, Antihero, Cinderella Complex) is writing the screenplay. Moshimoss is composing the music.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 New Voiced Trailer and October 20, 2026 Release Date Revealed
content: CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 has officially revealed the second trailer, along with an October 20, 2026 release date. Studio TRIGGER is back to animate. We recently spoke with the show’s writer and producer Bartosz Sztybor , who told us why they chose the studio and shared insights into the production.
author: Anime Corner

title: 3 Years Later, Naruto’s Successor Has Become the True Heir With Major Improvements
content: The Naruto manga and anime series has emerged as one of the most iconic franchises in the industry, and there is no doubt that it will remain so for many years to come. As a result, many new series are inevitably compared to Naruto , but few have come close to matching the ceiling the series has created.
author: ComicBook

title: Hollywood Reporter: Live-Action Naruto Film in Talks to Cast Charles Melton as Kakashi
content: Destin Daniel Cretton ( Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ) is directing the film, and is also producing the film through his company Hisako alongside Jeyun Munford . Arad Productions ' Avi Arad , Ari Arad , and Emmy Yu as well as Jeremy Latcham are listed as producers.
author: ANN
